test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Although one's body language is a very powerful medium of expression, we express our thoughts, verbally or__________ through language, which is our main way of communication.
solution:
The correct answer is '**textually**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**textually**" means in the form of text or in a way related to written or printed material.
 
• Verbal and textual communication are the primary ways we convey our thoughts and ideas.
 
• The other options: "**hyperbolically**," "**banefully**," and "**anemically**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Although one's body language is a very powerful medium of expression, we express our thoughts, verbally or textually__ through language, which is our main way of communication.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Hyperbolically (अतिशयोक्तिपूर्ण)**: means exaggeratedly.
 
• **Banefully (हानिकारक रूप से)**: means harmfully or destructively.
 
• **Anemically (रक्ताल्पताग्रस्त रूप में)**: means weakly or lacking vitality.

150:Tefb,
The correct answer is Option 3<
